data.body: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (2026-06-04): the override-propagation has TWO consumers, DD4 only wired ONE. (1) review-coverage-invariant.sh consults ael_sha_is_exempt (DD4 — 3 refs) -> FP-recovered SHAs are coverage-exempt. (2) verify-session-provenance.sh drives the llm-review DISPATCH (llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh: unprovenanced-shas non-empty -> dispatch full review) and does NOT consult the ledger (0 ael refs). v4 removed the DSO-Story trailer self-attestation, so provenance = 'linked to a GitHub PR that passed review'. #633's review-sub-pr FAILED (FP-recovered, merged via override), so its commits are UNPROVENANCED -> #634's llm-review dispatched a full re-review -> re-found the same FPs -> 2nd override. (My DD4 commits also lacked DSO-Story trailers, but v4 ignores trailers anyway; the operative cause is the failed-review linked PR.) FIX DIRECTION: extend override-propagation (DD4 unit 5) to make verify-session-provenance treat an HMAC-VALID admin-exemption-ledger SHA as provenanced (mirror the coverage-invariant wiring) — so PR2's llm-review provenance-SKIPS an FP-recovered commit. SECURITY: same trust model as DD4's coverage exemption (HMAC-signed by .closure-key + opus-gated FP-recovery), so no new laundering path. Pending panel review.
